hooks.name: Check a new meter format against the energy rules
hooks.description: When a fixture generator changes, ask the agent to confirm the format follows the unit, time and reading rules in energy-domain steering, and to add a property test if a new convention appears.

action.prompt: A meter export generator in backend/tests/fixtures.py changed. Read .kiro/steering/energy-domain.md. For the changed generator, state which conventions it uses (unit, interval start or end, time zone handling, cumulative or interval, decimal separator). If it introduces a convention that no test in backend/tests covers, add a focused unit test, and if the convention is an invariant, extend backend/tests/property/test_properties.py. Do not change parser code unless a test fails.
